#Setup

### Set Project Variables 
```{r set project variables}
Project <- "LOW"
TargetData <- "Ottawa_2025"
DataIn <- file.path("..","Data", "ProcessedData")
CalibData <- file.path("..","Data", "CalibData")
DataOut <- file.path("..","Data", "ProcessedData")

FileID <- "fit"

FileEncode <- "UTF-8" #guess_encoding says 'ASCII"

Delimiter <- ","

HeaderRows <- 0

#conversions
# us_s = 1000000
photons_umol = 6.022E17
A2_m2 = 1E20


#set colours
TempColours = c("black","violet",  "blue", "darkgreen", "green", "orange", "red", "darkred")

names(TempColours) <- c(2, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28)

TempColours
```


```{r read Chlamy_damping}
Chlamy_damping <- readRDS(file.path(DataIn, "LOW_Chlamy_damping.Rds", fsep = .Platform$file.sep)) 

```



```{r plots_dampingindex}

Chlamy_damping |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(x = PulseSpace_s, y = DampingIndex, colour = as.factor(NaCl_mM))) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(Temp_C), cols = vars(Strain)) +
  theme_bw()

Chlamy_damping |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(x = PulseSpace_s, y = DampingIndex, colour = as.factor(NaCl_mM))) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(Strain), cols = vars(TempDiff_C)) +
  theme_bw()

```
```{r anova}
Chlamy_aov <- aov(DampingIndex ~ Strain * LightLevel_ue * Temp_C * NaCl_mM,  data = Chlamy_damping)

summary(Chlamy_aov)
coefficients(Chlamy_aov)


ChlamyStrains_aov <- Chlamy_damping |>
  nest(data = -c("Strain")) |>
  mutate(Strains_aov = map(data, ~aov(DampingIndex ~ LightLevel_ue + Temp_C + NaCl_mM, data = .))
         ) |>
   mutate(Strains_aov_Param = map(Strains_aov, tidy)) |>
 # unnest(Strains_aov_Param,  names_sep = "_") |>      
  mutate(Strains_aovinteract = map(data, ~aov(DampingIndex ~ LightLevel_ue * Temp_C * NaCl_mM, data = .))
  ) |>
  mutate(Strains_aovinteract_Param = map(Strains_aovinteract, tidy)) |>
  unnest(Strains_aovinteract_Param, names_sep = "_") |>
  filter(Strains_aovinteract_Param_p.value <= 0.05)

  # CompareAOV = anova(ChlamyStrains_aov$Strains_aov[1], ChlamyStrains_aov$Strains_aovinteract[1])
  #     
         
   
         
         ) 

ChlamyStrains_aov_p <- ChlamyStrains_aov |>
  filter(p.value <= 0.05)


```
